_about: Adolf Holm (1830-1900): The History of Greece from its Commencement to the Close of the Independence of the Greek Nation, translated from the German, 4 vols. (London: Macmillan; title pages dated 1894, 1899, 1896, 1898), raw IA OCR. Vols. I-III name no translator; vol. IV names Frederick Clarke, formerly Taylorian Scholar at Oxford, and the machine check claims him for vol. IV only. Clarke's death year is not checked, so life-plus-70 status is unconfirmed (US public domain by date). Vol. II's 1899 is probably a later printing (pre-1930), since vol. III is dated 1896 (an inference). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted.
